operation_proposals.source_operation: Region-wise arithmetic-mean aggregation of WSI feature regions
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The source explicitly replaces every spatial region with its arithmetic mean. The pinned catalog has partition and projection primitives but no arithmetic aggregation operation. Under release 1.0.2 the step remains an opaque boundary and this proposal records the required source-backed catalog extension.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Pathway matching, grouping, and pooling of gene features
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The paper documents matching genes to biological pathway databases, grouping genes into pathways, and pooling each pathway. No existing primitive represents this correspondence-based grouping and pooling computation.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Optical character recognition from PDF diagnostic reports
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog represents symbolic tokenization and textual serialization, but no operation converts PDF content into extracted report text through OCR.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Downstream task-specific re-embedding of CLS tokens
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: Cross-attention exists, but the paper does not establish the query/key/value assignment, sequence order, or exact re-embedding schedule.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Inter-modal CLIP contrastive loss between modality CLS representations
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog contains representation transformations but no loss operation for pairwise CLIP contrastive learning.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Inter-sample cancer-category triplet-loss computation from sample-level CLS representations
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog contains concatenation and correspondence primitives but no metric-learning triplet-loss operation.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Modality-specific masked-language-model objective with random modality selection every 10 epochs
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog can represent some masking inputs but has no operation for the documented MLM prediction/loss computation or periodic random objective selection.
